question: Does an open early ego-neighbourhood (OPEN, t0..t0+2) anticipate later disciplinary breadth (O2r_m50, t0+6..t0+8) beyond size/growth/breadth, concept type, pre-onset footprint, coverage and field, on a fresh 2015-2017 onset cohort scored once from a sealed spec?

learned_models_frozen_exp8.O4_EBM: not evaluable: O4 not computed (no citation pass; declared drop)

U6_psp.criterion: exact equality with EXP8 rq1stats AND the 95% CI covers the planted 0.10 (n = 1000, SE ~ 0.03, so CI > 0 alone has only ~85% power)

type_benchmark.decision: gate failed twice (method precision 0.733 -> 0.800 < 0.85; object 1.000 -> 0.875): type dummies use M1 (v2 prompt); within-type tests use concepts where M1 = M2 (declared fallback)
type_benchmark.gold_reader: executor agent (LLM), blind to model labels; not a human annotator

seal.seal_log: logs/seal.log (hash-chained JSON lines: S0_prereg, S8_freeze, S9_unseal, S9_outcomes, S9_scored)

deviations.S3_outcome_grounding: outcome-blind S3 rule -> TAG (tag-rate min ratio 1.013, control ratio 0.902; MATCH validation rho 0.937); primary = TAG t0+6..t0+8
deviations.precision_gate_retry: 13 candidates had no parsable gate label; one retry (2 calls of 5 titles) labelled 13; remaining unlabelled are excluded (no MiniLM sense-filter fallback in this artifact)
deviations.s9_post_freeze_edit: s9_unseal.py was edited AFTER the S8 freeze (before the unseal) only to add a --dryrun mode on synthetic counts and a resume-from-hashed-outcomes path; the scoring logic, rungs, verdict code and constants are unchanged (git diff between commits shows it). frozen_spec.json was not modified.
deviations.type_gate_failed_twice: Type benchmark gate failed twice (M1 method precision 0.733 with the v1 prompt, 0.800 with the one allowed revision v2; object 1.000 / 0.875). Declared fallback: type dummies use M1 v2 labels; within-type tests use concepts with M1 = M2 (openai/gpt-4.1-mini labelled all 9,751 M1 method/object concepts; agreement 0.90). Gold labels were read by the executor agent, not a human.
deviations.O4_dropped: No citation pass (referenced_works not read); O4 and the O4 EBM replication are not evaluated (declared first drop).
deviations.home_rule_cap: Cohort home rule counts only years <= t0+2 (outcome-blind); EXP5 had no cap.
deviations.extension_2017: Power for the 2015-16 cohort was 0.139 (< 0.80), so the declared 2017 extension was applied before the seal (n = 1,443; window t0+5..t0+7 for 2017 onsets; window flag is collinear with the 2017 onset dummy and absorbed by it).
